summary: CRT file-stream logical position/remaining-bytes calculator. Reads the OS file handle at this+0x10, clamps a negative position (this+0x4) to 0, queries the physical file size via sub_58C724, then adjusts the buffered position for text-mode newline (0x0A) expansion using the per-handle text-mode descriptor reached through dword_8D4920. Returns -1 with errno set to 22 (EINVAL) via TLSOffsetGetter when stream mode flags are invalid. Invoked by FileTellSeekPositionQuery and FileSizeQueryWrapper for file size/position queries.

local_names.a1: FILE-style stream descriptor (handle, position, buffer pointers, mode flags)
local_names.v2: OS file handle read from this+0x10
local_names.v19: physical file size returned by sub_58C724
local_names.v18: logical buffer-consumed byte count (this+0x0 - this+0x8) plus newline adjustments
local_names.v20: pending byte-window estimate revalidated against the file size

operations.description: Read the OS file handle from this+0x10; when the buffered position this+0x4 is negative, clamp it to 0.
Query the physical file size with sub_58C724(handle, 0, 1) into v19; on a negative result return -1.
Read stream mode flags from this+0xC; when (flags & 0x108) == 0 the stream is in a simple buffered state, so return v19 - this+0x4 as the raw logical position.
Compute the buffered-consumed byte count v18 = this+0x0 (buffer end) - this+0x8 (current read pointer).

When the flags this+0xC low mode bits are non-zero (text-mode path) and the per-handle text-mode descriptor byte at dword_8D4920[handle >> 5] + 36 * (handle & 0x1F) + 4 is negative, scan the buffered bytes from this+0x8 up to this+0x0 and count each 0x0A (10) byte into v18.
When (flags & 0x80) == 0 the stream mode combination is invalid: write 22 into the TLS errno slot via TLSOffsetGetter() and return -1.
When the physical file size v19 is 0, return the adjusted consumed count v18 directly.
When the byte-level flag (this+0xC & 1) is set and the buffered position this+0x4 is nonzero, estimate the pending window v20 = this+0x4 + this+0x0 - this+0x8.

Revalidate the window against the file: a second size probe sub_58C724(handle, 0, 2) equal to v19 means the file is unchanged, so count 0x0A (10) bytes inside the window from this+0x8 and derive the adjustment flag v14 from (this+0xD & 0x20) == 0; otherwise seek back via sub_58C724(handle, v19, 0) and pick v20 = 512 or the buffer size this+0x18 based on v20 > 0x200, (flags & 8) == 0, or (flags & 0x400) != 0, deriving v14 from the text-mode descriptor flag byte instead.
Finish by subtracting the validated window from the physical size and adding the consumed count: return v19 - v20 + v18.
Function 0x0058AD08 is the shared size/position query invoked by FileTellSeekPositionQuery and FileSizeQueryWrapper.

unresolved: The exact semantic roles of flag bits 0x400 and the 0x200 window threshold (line-buffering / ungetc state) are not recoverable from this function alone.
The text-mode descriptor byte at dword_8D4920[handle >> 5] + 36 * (handle & 0x1F) + 4 is external state; only its sign and its & 4 bit are consumed here.
The buffer-size field this+0x18 is used only in the fallback path where the second size probe differs from the stored size.
